snippet.title: AP | 2025 Holiday - Unveil Your Beauty Beyond : The City Lights - Behind the Scene
snippet.description:
AP 2025 HOLIDAY : UNVEIL YOUR BEAUTY BEYOND
AP BEAUTY × JIEUN PARK — The City Lights

From Seoul to New York to Hong Kong,
AP BEAUTY unveils a new holiday artwork series
inspired by the luminous rhythm of three iconic cities —a captivating partnership with artist JIEUN PARK.

Renowned for portraying city nights as “emotional landscapes,”Jieun Park’s work intertwines neon reflections and human introspection,capturing the delicate tension between light and shadow, stillness and energy.
Through this collaboration, “Unveil Your Beauty Beyond” evolves into an artistic statement.
From the starlight shimmering above Seoul Tower,to the bold neon glow of the Empire State Building,and the golden waves drifting along Hong Kong’s Victoria Harbour,each landmark captures the brilliance of a world alive with light.

The cascading layers of light within her art embodyAP BEAUTY’s harmony of science and sensibility,and visualize the brand’s philosophy: beauty that begins with light.

This holiday season where art meets beauty,
AP BEAUTY invites you to a journey  
where inner brilliance expands beyond the city lights.

snippet.title: AP BEAUTY | Rebranding 1st Anniversary Campaign : APEX OF SKINCARE, SINCE 1945
snippet.description:
Commemorating the 1st Anniversary of AP BEAUTY's rebranding, we honor AP's great journey and unwavering dedication to beauty and skin science.
From its founding in 1945, 80 years of continuous research, and the culmination of 23 years of luxury specialization, join us in celebrating AP BEAUTY's new beginning 
where tradition and innovation meet to offer an unparalleled luxury experience and innovative skincare solutions.

1945: The origin of Amorepacific Group and the history of beauty and skin science. It symbolizes the start of a journey towards the apex of skincare innovation.

80: Eighty years of skin science heritage. It signifies AP's ongoing commitment to and innovation in the field of skin science, surpassing the boundaries of existing technology.

23: AP, a flagship luxury brand meticulously crafted with only the highest-functioning and innovative products. It represents the history of AP BEAUTY, reinvented based on Amorepacific's 23 years of expertise.

아름다운의 새로운 경지를 여는 스킨케어의 정점, 에이피 뷰티(AP BEAUTY)가 리브랜딩 1주년을 맞이하였습니다.
23년전 뉴욕에서 첫 런칭했던 에이피 뷰티(AP Beauty)는 아모레퍼시픽의 피부 과학 연구 자산의 집약체로 최상의 솔루션만을 선보이는 고성능 하이엔드 스킨케어 브랜드입니다. 1945년 아모레퍼시픽 그룹 창립 연도부터 시작된 아름다움을 향한 여정과 80년 이상의 스킨 사이언스 헤리티지를 바탕으로 재탄생한 에이피 뷰티의 리브랜딩 1주년을 축하해주세요.
독보적인 고효능 스킨케어 솔루션을 제안하는 에이피 뷰티의 앞으로의 여정도 기대해주세요.
